title: Coltens-World: Architecture Boundary Rules
description: Enforce strict import boundaries to maintain clean monorepo architecture

rules.name: no-app-to-app-imports
rules.description: Applications cannot import from other applications
rules.rationale: Apps should be independent. Share code via packages/ instead.

rules.name: apps-can-import-packages
rules.description: Applications can import from packages (public exports only)
rules.rationale: Apps consume shared libraries. Use public index.ts exports.

rules.name: no-dist-imports
rules.description: Never import from dist/ folder directly
rules.rationale: Import source instead. Build system handles compilation.

rules.name: no-deep-package-imports
rules.description: Don't import from another package's internals
rules.rationale: Packages expose APIs via src/index.ts. Use those.

rules.name: contracts-first
rules.description: Contracts (schemas) must be generated before runtime imports
rules.rationale: Contracts are source of truth. Codegen happens before runtime.

rules.name: protocol-is-foundational
rules.description: protocol/ can be imported by everything; nothing imports deeper
rules.rationale: Protocol is foundation. Build order: protocol → engine → everything else.

rules.name: no-cycle-engine-to-apps
rules.rationale: Apps depend on engine. Reverse dependency creates cycles.

rules.name: ledger-is-self-contained
rules.description: ledger-contracts only imports from protocol and contracts
rules.rationale: Ledger contracts are foundational. Keep dependency tree shallow.

rules.name: python-sidecar-isolation
rules.description: Python sidecar should only call HTTP endpoints, not import TS packages
rules.rationale: Python and TS are separate runtimes. Communicate via HTTP/gRPC.

exceptions.reason: Nucleus is the app wrapper for engine. Special case allowed.
Build tooling needs access to all packages for codegen.
automation-index is a registry of all modules. Needs visibility.
